mechanism_sentence: The replay's structure-stop check re-derives the closed-5min-bar-close deterministically from a complete, gap-free SPY CSV at every 1-minute step of the walk, while the live engine only re-evaluates that SAME closed-bar value once per actual heartbeat tick (nominally ~1/min but informationally 5-min-native) using whatever bar happened to be current at that tick's fetch -- so a transient dip through the trigger level that the replay's exhaustive scan always catches can be a dip live's discrete, tick-gated polling never armed on (10 of 14 structure-misfire rows are exactly this: a real tp1+trail/premium_stop winner or small loser that the replay converts into a structure-stop loss, and 10 of those 14 collapse into 3 underlying signal-days replicated across arms).
